We all have that friend who manages to keep every aspect of their life in order, whether that means planning hangouts or keeping their home spick and span. On the other hand, we also have those friends who might need a little intervention when it comes to keeping things tidy.
No matter which type of person you’re shopping for, we’ve rounded up a list of gift ideas that are sure to help them keep their day-to-day running smoothly.

From must-have home tech products to travel bags with built-in organizational components, these ingenious picks will allow your besties to stay focused on the fun parts of everyday life regardless of whether they’re chilling at home or taking a vacation. There isn’t a ton of time left to shop before the December holidays arrive, so have a look through the products below, and order them now to have plenty of wrapping time to spare.

A cute storage basket is a great way to keep things out of the way while still contributing to a room’s overall decor. This scalloped basket from Anthropologie is one your giftee will proudly keep out in the open, and they can use it to store pretty much anything, from blankets and toys to shoes, towels, and more.

Durable and sturdy, Cadence Parcels are the only toiletry bags you’ll ever need. The clear plastic material makes it easy to locate whatever’s inside, and even easier to wipe clean in case of spills. But the best part has to be the magnetic closure — it snaps together alongside other Parcels to create a tray-like organization system.

Ensure their desktop stays in working order with Apto’s Align Desk Caddy. It features a cup for pens and pencils, and slots for notebooks, files, or your phone. They can even pin magnets to its smooth, steel surface.

Their book stack will look so much neater on this IKEA find. The KOMPISHÄNG bookend features a curved steel silhouette that cradles books, along with convenient handles that allow your giftee to carry it from room to room. Its red, powder-coated exterior makes for a cool pop of color, too.

Closet storage is often one of those finite resources, so knowing how to optimize that space to fit everything you need is essential. One way to do it is with an over-the-door rack such as this one from Umbra, which features a whopping 14 hooks for hats, coats, bags, accessories, and so much more.

This countertop drawer can be used for practically anything. Use it to elevate small appliances like a coffee maker or tea kettle and keep pods or tea bags out of sight, or for sleek concealed storage in a bathroom or on a dresser. When it comes to use cases, the possibilities are endless.

Transform their trunk with this handy car organizer. It expands like an accordion, revealing three roomy compartments for groceries, sports equipment, and those clothing donations that have been rolling around your car for months.

If you have a friend who's constantly looking for ways to improve their packing efficiency, then this is the suitcase for them. It’s basically a closet on wheels: you can pack items on their hangers, and there are tons of pockets to keep everything from folded clothes and shoes to jewelry and accessories organized. I wouldn’t have survived wedding season without it!

For the person who considers the airport their second home, a set of smart packing cubes are sure to become a beloved part of their routine. This set from Quince can be compressed up to 60% to maximize space in their luggage, and comes in an assortment of color and count options.

This Quince tote bag has pockets galore, which makes it the perfect work or travel bag. The durable, water-repellant material holds up against rain and scuffs, and it features an expandable lower compartment that offers four additional inches of packing space — perfect for the people who are always schlepping a ton of stuff.

If your loved one is looking to downsize their physical book collection, the Kobo Clara Colour is a great place to start. This e-reader comes with 16GB of storage to help them meet their reading goals, and it also allows readers to highlight in full color. Plus, it automatically reduces blue light to minimize eye strain — and it’s totally waterproof, so you can read anywhere.

This calendar takes the simple communal calendar up a huge notch. This digital display connects to wifi to your calendar software of choice between Apple, Google, Outlook, Cozi, or Yahoo. Combined with the mobile app, you’ll never lose track of your schedule again.

Throw it back to high school with this cute locker storage option, perfect for a home office space. This features two adjustable shelves, two cable holes, and two wall attachment points. It also comes in eleven colors to match any space.
